title: RelayMoved v1
description: Fact: the media-relay replica owning a call stopped heartbeating and another replica adopted the call; clients must send audio to the new address. Channel: SQS relay-results (media-relay -> call-signaling).

signalAddr.description: Optional (added 2026-11-18, backward compatible): host:port of the owning media-relay pod's internal HTTP API, where call-signaling forwards WebRTC offers.
